request.chain: exact client cf-ray -> worker observation correlation -> S00 traceId -> trace and sdt.observe/v1 correlation queries
request.identityHandling: The local source retained exact fixture CF-Ray IDs. This committed audit preserves only ordinal/hash failure identities.

providerRetention.source: Workers Logs retention is provider/config dependent and short (commonly 3 or 7 days); availability is measured by this bounded read-only query, not inferred from missing joins.

correlationGroupSummary.interpretation: At correlation-group scope, all 46 joined request groups retain one Journal activation ID. Existing do.handler facts do not retain S04/S05 row identity, so no individual S04 or S05 fact is inferred from observation order.

exactS04Conclusions.statement: P0 remains PARTIAL: every S04-specific activation claim is UNKNOWN, rather than inferred from correlation-group ordering.

distributions.scope: All correlation-joined JOURNAL do.handler facts; no per-row S04 distribution is claimed.

semanticLimits.constructorToHandlerMs: Begins only after the platform has instantiated the JavaScript class. It excludes routing, placement, and pre-construction startup; it is not a platform cold-start timer.
semanticLimits.firstStorageReadMs: Captured immediately before the first durable read or transaction begins. It is handler-entry-to-storage-touch, not storage-read latency.
